headline: Apple unveils all-new iPad mini: OLED display, thinner design
summary: Apple calls it the “biggest update ever” for the iPad mini, featuring a stunning new OLED display and a significantly thinner profile.
details: Apple has officially unveiled its latest iPad mini, touting it as the "biggest update ever" for the compact tablet line. The new model boasts a vibrant OLED display and a more refined, thinner design.

The device features a larger screen-to-body ratio thanks to slimmer bezels, contributing to its overall sleeker appearance. This redesign aims to enhance the user experience for portability and immersion.

While specific pricing and availability details are yet to be fully disclosed, Apple has confirmed that this represents a significant leap forward for the iPad mini series, promising enhanced visuals and a more premium feel.

topic: iphone duo models breaking, ifixit teardown offers explanation
headline_marked: [[iPhone Duo inner screens]] reportedly cracking, iFixit teardown offers clues
headline: iPhone Duo inner screens reportedly cracking, iFixit teardown offers clues
summary: Multiple users report the new foldable phone's display cracking shortly after setup, with repair experts investigating potential causes.
details: The first batch of Apple's new iPhone Duo foldable phones may be experiencing screen issues, with multiple Reddit reports indicating the inner display cracks shortly after users begin setting up the device. This emerging problem has already been dubbed "crackgate" by some.

It remains unclear how widespread this issue is, as Apple has not yet commented on the reports. However, this is not the first time foldable phones have faced screen durability challenges, with early models from other manufacturers also experiencing cracking and hinge-related problems.

Repair company iFixit has released a teardown of the iPhone Duo, providing a provisional repairability score of 5/10, the highest they've given a foldable device. Their analysis may shed light on why the screens are reportedly cracking.

While the battery and outer components are relatively easy to access and replace, iFixit notes that the inner display is the most fragile and difficult part to service. The thin nano-texture finish on the OLED screen can be easily peeled off if not handled carefully.

The teardown also highlights that dust can accumulate along the inner hinge, causing a "crunchy" sound similar to issues seen in earlier foldable phones. The repair manual for the iPhone Duo was made widely accessible on launch day, a positive step for device repairability.

The iPhone Duo's inner screen repair service costs $999, making the potential for cracking a significant concern for owners of the $1,999 device. The accessibility of repair information is a notable improvement from Apple's previous repair programs.
